subject: Re: Cochlear implant pipeline kickoff — from hackathon code to accessibility demo
body:
Goran,

Plan:

Staffing — Efe 50% (enhancement model + retraining), Milan 40% (pipeline engineering: notebooks → batch pipeline, electrodogram generation), Halima 40% (eval: vocoder-simulation listening workflow + objective metrics, plus the YAMNet mixing-threshold study).

Compute — light until June: pipeline and eval work runs on 8 best-effort A100s. The heavy event is the enhancement-model retrain on our current speech corpora. Ines's team has us down for the vulcan-h100 reservation — 512 accelerators for the week of 2026-06-22 — which is when we retrain the enhancement model at full scale. Sized for a 4-day run plus headroom; cc'ing Ines for the record.

One dependency to start now: the vocoder simulation toolchain needs a license/attribution check before an internal demo. I'll open the thread with Kofi.

Bruno
